sources.title: Vikings Emerge as Early Favorites to Win the NFC North
sources.description: In what seems like a long time ago already, but still only two weeks ago, the Minnesota Vikings were projected to finish at the bottom of the NFC North and had the longest odds to win the division at +550 or so just prior to the start of the season. But after a 2-0 start […]
